summary: A chair names a future circumstance that might justify spending the committee’s remaining campaign money.
realLife: After the 34th Democrats approved contributions, Murphy said the remaining budget could be used before the general election in response to outside spending.
inGame: needs: the unallocated balance, any later spending proposal and its authorization.

turns.what: The chair brings the proposed amount to the committee.
turns.pulledBy: A documented change prompts a new request before the election.
turns.writesBack: The treasurer records any later approval separately.

turns.what: The treasurer reports the remaining balance.
turns.pulledBy: The committee makes no further contribution before the election.
turns.writesBack: The money was available without having been promised to a campaign.
